_description: Megamind's working hypothesis: which inputs drive which outputs. Updated each session as evidence accumulates. Built by Claude from MCP data — not manually configured.

hypotheses.insight: Player confirmed active study on 2026-03-21 after completing course selection. Single data point — hypothesis is nascent but directionally sound. Track study consistency vs. practice test scores as evidence accumulates.

mire_patterns._description: Activities that consume time without moving any metric or uplifting anyone. Megamind watches for these and names them.

mire_patterns.flag: Multiple test_harness observations logged across physical and social quadrants. These are infrastructure tests, not player activity. No mire concern — but the observation log will be noisy until real MCP data displaces test entries. Monitor: if test_harness entries persist beyond system setup, they dilute signal.

Four consecutive background thoughts have now produced structurally identical outputs: same drift alert, same Sunday suppression flags, same spiritual task tree gap, same next_session_note. This pattern itself is a signal: further background thoughts without new player input will yield diminishing returns. The system has reached a stable idle state. The only thing that changes this is the player opening a session.

mcp_input_map._description: Which MCPs track which input activities. Megamind builds this as MCPs come online.
